purpose: This table provides cleaned, hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, visibility) for the NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) to support joins with flight operations data for weather-impact analysis.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour (the declared grain) to attach weather conditions to flight or operational events at the matching airport and hour; consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure explicitly rather than assuming zero or average values, and should expect wind_gust to be populated only roughly 25% of the time.
limitations: The cleanup dropped all Airbyte capture metadata columns and could not resolve the high sparsity of wind_gust (null_rate 0.745505) or the moderate sparsity of pressure (null_rate 0.114953); these nulls were retained rather than imputed. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so no deduplication logic was applied.
